title: Binchotan Beef Patty Stir Fry
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Chinese-inspired stir-fry dish using a binchotan-grilled beef patty.

ingredients.name: Binchotan-grilled beef patty
ingredients.notes: Cook to an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C)

ingredients.name: Kissed by binchotan sauce
ingredients.notes: Available pre-made or make your own

ingredients.name: Brazilian chilies
ingredients.notes: Adjust to desired level of spiciness

instructions: Heat 1 tsp of sesame oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the Brazilian chilies and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the Binchotan-grilled beef patty and cook for 2-3 minutes, until browned.
Add the kissed by binchotan sauce, soy sauce, and brown sugar. Stir to combine.
Add the By binchotan stir-fry vegetables and cook until they are tender-crisp.
Transfer the stir-fry to a serving plate and garnish with scallions.
